source.scope_note: This manually reviewed fixture is based only on the archived extracted text stored for CN_Project_Doc.pdf. The raw PDF was unavailable, and equivalence to CN_Project.pdf has not been established. Evidence line numbers refer to the archived extracted text, not PDF pages.
source.matching_policy: The expected task set contains distinct named work groups and deliverables, not every lower-level acceptance criterion. Matching is one-to-one: one predicted task may match at most one expected task. A broad or compound prediction does not receive credit for multiple independently actionable expected tasks.

expected_tasks.title: Establish the private LAN and record machine/network details

evidence.quote: Connect all available team Macs to the same private Wi-Fi or LAN segment.
Record each Mac's private IPv4 address, subnet mask/prefix, default gateway, active interface name, and MAC address.
Verify basic reachability between every pair of machines using ping.
Create a topology diagram clearly showing the four machine roles and how they are connected.

expected_tasks.title: Configure and verify the private DNS server and client resolvers

evidence.quote: Create DNS records that resolve:
Configure at least two other Macs to use Mac 1 as their DNS resolver
Verify resolution using dig app.teamX.test or nslookup app.teamX.test from a client machine.

expected_tasks.title: Build the two HTTP REST backend services

evidence.quote: Mac 3 and Mac 4 each run a small HTTP REST backend.
Task C   Build Two Simple Backend Services

expected_tasks.title: Configure nginx as the reverse proxy and load balancer

evidence.quote: Mac 2 runs nginx and acts as the single public entry point.
Use round-robin load balancing (or another clearly explained strategy such as least_conn).
Verify that repeated requests to the same domain name are served alternately by Backend A and Backend B.

expected_tasks.title: Configure HTTPS/TLS and establish client certificate trust

evidence.quote: The edge service must serve traffic over HTTPS using a valid certificate.
Create a self-signed certificate for app.teamX.test using OpenSSL
Add your local CA certificate to the trust store of every client Mac

expected_tasks.title: Demonstrate HTTP caching behavior

evidence.quote: At least one endpoint must demonstrate proper HTTP cache headers
Demonstrate a repeated request showing that the client reuses cached content, or a conditional request returning 304 Not Modified.

expected_tasks.title: Capture and explain the complete protocol flow

evidence.quote: Using Wireshark, tcpdump, curl, and browser tools, you must collect evidence that every layer of the stack is working correctly for a single client request.
Layer / Event What You Must Show and Explain

expected_tasks.title: Demonstrate the wrong-DNS-server client failure scenario

evidence.quote: You must deliberately break your setup in the following ways and explain what you observe and why it happens.
Wrong DNS server configured on a client

expected_tasks.title: Demonstrate the DNS record pointing to a wrong IP scenario

evidence.quote: DNS record points to a wrong IP address
DNS resolution succeeds but the client is sent to the wrong destination.

expected_tasks.title: Demonstrate service behavior when one backend is stopped

evidence.quote: One backend is stopped
The edge should continue serving requests through the remaining backend

expected_tasks.title: Demonstrate service behavior when both backends are stopped

evidence.quote: Both backends are stopped
the application returns a clear upstream failure (502 Bad Gateway).

expected_tasks.title: Demonstrate the wrong destination port failure scenario

evidence.quote: Wrong destination port on the client
The host is reachable but the TCP connection to the service port fails.

expected_tasks.title: Configure a backup DNS resolver and demonstrate resolver failover

evidence.quote: Run a second DNS resolver on another Mac (not Mac 1) with the same project DNS records.
Stop the primary DNS service (stop dnsmasq on Mac 1) and show that clients continue to resolve names using the backup.

expected_tasks.title: Demonstrate DNS TTL expiry, record change, and cache flushing

evidence.quote: Set a short, clearly visible TTL (e.g., 30 seconds) on a project DNS record.
Demonstrate flushing the DNS cache manually and observing the immediate change.

expected_tasks.title: Restrict direct client access to backend ports and preserve rollback

evidence.quote: Restrict direct access to backend ports (3001 and 3002) so that only Mac 2 (the edge) can reach the backends.
Maintain a rollback copy of any firewall rules and restore the original configuration after the demonstration.

expected_tasks.title: Demonstrate backend health failover and recovery

evidence.quote: Configure nginx to detect backend unavailability and route only to the healthy backend.
Restart Backend A and demonstrate that load balancing resumes distributing across both backends.

expected_tasks.title: Configure a standby edge and demonstrate DNS-based migration

evidence.quote: Configure a standby nginx on another Mac (can be Mac 3 or Mac 4 temporarily) with the same configuration.
Update the DNS record for app.teamX.test to point to the standby edge machine.

expected_tasks.title: Diagnose the faculty-injected fault systematically

evidence.quote: During the evaluation, the faculty will introduce one configuration fault into your running system.
Use systematic diagnosis: check name resolution first, then TCP connectivity, then TLS, then the application layer.

notes.event_rationale: The text describes reviews, evaluation slots, and a final demonstration, but the archived text includes no actual calendar date or time for a scheduled occurrence. Those items are treated as deliverable milestones/tasks rather than date-specific events.
notes.blocker_rationale: The failure scenarios are deliberately induced demonstrations and hypothetical system states, not evidence of an existing project condition that blocks progress.
notes.owner_rationale: No person or task-specific owner is assigned. Collective references to the team do not identify an individual owner.
notes.deadline_rationale: The deliverables table has seven explicit phase/review milestones, but none provides a specific calendar date. These milestone strings are retained as deadline_text evidence, not converted into dates.
